GoalOptions.Label: Enable Integration
GoalOptions.Text: This document aims to equip Junior Developers and System Integrators with the detailed understanding required to seamlessly integrate new ML inference models into the IPAH Core Services. Success means they can confidently connect, configure, and test ML services with minimal friction, ensuring data flow and process orchestration are robust.

GoalOptions.Label: Ensure Stability
GoalOptions.Text: For DevOps and operations teams, a primary goal is to ensure the operational stability and reliability of the ML inference pipeline within IPAH. This document should enable them to understand deployment strategies, monitoring requirements, and error handling mechanisms, leading to predictable performance and high availability of automated processes.

GoalOptions.Label: Facilitate Deployment
GoalOptions.Text: The document's goal is to facilitate the efficient and scalable deployment of ML inference components across various environments. Readers should be able to automate deployment processes, manage dependencies, and scale resources effectively to meet fluctuating demand for intelligent process automation tasks, minimizing manual intervention.

GoalOptions.Label: Promote Best Practices
GoalOptions.Text: This document seeks to promote engineering best practices for developing, testing, and maintaining ML inference services within the IPAH ecosystem. Junior Developers should gain insights into robust model versioning, data contract adherence, and secure API design, fostering a culture of high-quality, maintainable AI solutions.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical Performance
Criteria: ML inference latency meets defined SLA for critical business processes.
Model prediction accuracy maintains specified thresholds under production load.
Resource utilization (CPU, GPU, memory) for inference services remains within allocated budgets.
API contracts for ML services are clearly defined and strictly adhered to by integrators.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Operational Readiness
Criteria: Deployment of ML inference services is fully automated via CI/CD pipelines.
Comprehensive monitoring and alerting are in place for model health and inference performance.
Logging provides sufficient detail for debugging and auditing ML process execution.
Rollback procedures for new ML model versions are clearly documented and tested.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Business & Compliance
Criteria: Automated processes leveraging ML inference achieve targeted business outcome improvements (e.g., reduced manual effort, increased throughput).
Data privacy and security requirements for ML model inputs and outputs are fully met.
Audit trails for ML inference decisions and data transformations are robust and accessible.
Explainability mechanisms for critical ML predictions are implemented where regulatory or business needs dictate.
